_comment: HPCA2027 revision: ideal load + store fusion (--ideal_fusion_stores 1: store pairs with no store in between, as in Helios) pass 1 on the MICRO'22 Helios paper baseline (scarab/src/PARAMS.helios_paper, Table II, Ramulator DRAM) on SPEC CPU2017 speed int. Pass 1 logs every fusible load pair (no timing change, so it is also the no-fusion baseline). Fusion window = the 352-entry ROB. Each trace is one fixed Helios region; each run warms up for 20M instructions from instruction 1, then measures the next 100M (inst_limit 120M). Candidates live in tmpfs (application_dir, mounted at /tmp_home/application). Scarab branch hpca2027-revision-ideal-fusion. Launch with json/hpca2027-revision/helios_paper_ideal_fusion.sh --stores.
